title: Freezing at the Communion cover in a Barnes & Noble
summary: John Blitch tells of Freezing at the Communion cover in a Barnes & Noble, about around the mountain-bike incident (1990s) at Barnes & Noble in a mall, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency for advanced technology, says he was once taken by an alien. He tells of walking through a Barnes & Noble bookstore in a mall in the 1990s, around the time of an incident on his mountain bike, and spotting the cover of Communion, a book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own alien encounters, with its large-eyed face. He says he froze in his tracks, as if he recognised that face.
